paper.title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
paper.central_claim: Declarative LM programs (signatures, modules) compiled by teleprompters that bootstrap metric-filtered demonstrations replace hand-written prompt templates and outperform standard few-shot prompting and, in some cells, expert demonstrations on GSM8K and HotPotQA, within minutes of compiling.

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: abstract, all main sections and the appendices relevant to every disputed field (targeted reads of the pinned extraction)

evidence.quote: long strings of instructions and demonstrations that are hand crafted through manual trial and error. We argue that this approach, while pervasive, can be brittle and unscalable—conceptually akin to hand-tuning the weights for a classifier. A given string prompt might not generalize to different pipelines or across different LMs, data domains, or even inputs.

This teleprompter will simulate a teacher program (or, if unset, the zero-shot version of the program being compiled) on some training inputs, possibly one or more times with a high temperature. When running in
compile
mode, multi-stage traces are tracked transparently and in a thread-safe fashion throughout execution. We thus obtain potential labels for all signatures in the program by throwing away the bad examples and using the good examples as potential demonstrations, though these design decisions are under user control.

signatures.object: 每个 Predict 的 demonstration 参数；基本 LM 冻结
signatures.information: 用户程序/signature，少量训练输入，任务 metric，兼容教师（可默认学生自身）；部分任务使用末端答案标签
signatures.operation: 递归映射 predictor→执行教师并记录各节点输入输出→整程序 metric 过滤→将通过轨迹中的局部示例附入相应模块
signatures.output: 有自动 demonstrations 的 compiled_program
signatures.conditions: 程序须能偶尔通过 metric；教师/学生 predictor 可映射；末端通过不蕴含所有中间步骤正确
signatures.feedback: 端到端数值正确率/答案 EM/用户约束
signatures.selection_rule: 只保留通过 metric 的训练轨迹；后续候选搜索另选
signatures.selection_data: 训练集（数学200；HotPot200），不含最终测试
signatures.persistence: 返回拷贝程序各 predictor.demonstrations；不是只保留当前答案
signatures.later_use: 新问题推理时用模块化示例提示；可作为下一次编译的 teacher
signatures.claimed_effect: 无手写中间标签也能获得多阶段条件化示例
signatures.failure_boundary: 弱初始模型无有效轨迹时难启动；信用分配只是整体通过门控；权重更新分支不计入此签名

signatures.object: 各模块示例子集及可选 ensemble
signatures.information: 已过滤候选，train/validation metric，预设调用图
signatures.operation: 随机打乱/选示例编译多个候选→验证打分→保留最大分者或组合 top candidates
signatures.output: 固定 compiled prompt/program 或多数投票 ensemble
signatures.conditions: 选择集代表未来任务；选集与报告集隔离；足够调用预算
signatures.selection_rule: 交叉验证/validation 最优；ensemble 聚合多个已编译候选
signatures.selection_data: GSM8K development300；HotPot train交叉验证；不是 test
signatures.persistence: compiled program 的 demonstrations 与外围 ensemble 结构
signatures.later_use: 固定候选用于官方 GSM test / HotPot 保留样本，不继续用测试标签更新
signatures.claimed_effect: 编译后跨输入提高最终准确率
signatures.failure_boundary: ensemble 增加测试调用；非任意架构自动搜索；验证噪声/搜索过拟合未完整审计

signatures.object: Demonstrations (and optionally weights) of each Predict module in a multi-stage LM pipeline; baseline: hand-written prompt templates / random labeled few-shot
signatures.information: Training inputs with at most final-output labels; metric function; teacher or zero-shot program; traces of every module call
signatures.operation: Run teacher program on training inputs, keep traces whose final output passes the metric, store them as per-module demonstrations; optionally random search / Optuna over demo subsets using a dev set; optionally nest or ensemble
signatures.output: Compiled program (Python object holding demos) ; optionally finetuned small LM
signatures.conditions: Metric computable on final output; program decomposed so that some training inputs yield passing traces
signatures.selection_rule/data: Metric filter on training traces; best of random-search trials on dev (16 trials in pseudocode); top-7 for ensembles
signatures.persistence: Demonstrations stored in the compiled program
signatures.later_use: Injected in the prompt of each module for all later inputs
signatures.claimed_effect: GSM8K and HotPotQA accuracy gains (e.g. GPT-3.5 CoT 72.9 test, ensemble 81.6; multihop test 39.6 EM, ensemble 45.6 on half set)
signatures.failure_boundary: No regression/rollback rule; no handling of metric gaming; compile needs a program that can already pass the metric on some inputs

signatures.object: Pipeline program expressed as signatures and modules
signatures.operation: Replace string prompts with signature-defined modules (Predict, ChainOfThought, ReAct, MultiChainComparison)
signatures.claimed_effect: H1: comparable quality without hand-crafted prompts
signatures.failure_boundary: program structure effect confounded with compilation (E016, E017)

gap.author_gap: LM pipelines are built from hand-written, brittle prompt templates that do not transfer across LMs or pipelines.
gap.checked_gap: Real and well-placed for 2023; evidence of the burden is an informal census, and nearest prompt-optimisation / rationale-bootstrapping neighbours are only named.
gap.closest_adjacent: Single-call prompt optimisers and rationale bootstrapping
gap.residue: Optimising intermediate demonstrations of multi-stage pipelines from end-to-end metrics only.
gap.stakes: Portability of LM pipelines across models and tasks.
gap.method_response: Signatures/modules + teleprompters that bootstrap metric-filtered traces and select demonstration sets by search.
gap.remaining_gap: Budget-matched and filter-ablated evidence, variance, and comparison with other optimisers.

rs_pattern.reason: Load-bearing operation: manufacture per-module supervision from the model's own metric-filtered traces (both seats). Supporting: prompting recast as discrete selection solved by RS/TPE; deployment as demonstrations conditioning a frozen LM. No sub-card fits.

matches.tactic_steps_checked: missing intermediate labels → traces filtered by end-to-end metric → used as demonstrations; filter never ablated.
matches.success_failure_checks: curation stage present; isolating baseline vs extra compute missing
matches.reason: C07/C08/C26 do not match (no internal-state signal, no retraining data factory in the evaluated branch, no preference objective).

matches.tactic_steps_checked: demonstration choice recast as hyper-parameter search; reduction asserted not proven
compiled demonstrations condition a frozen LM; no upstream schema training or structural holdout (C03 not met)
matches.success_failure_checks: multiple settings met; category-level generalisation not claimed
matches.reason: Delivery channel of the retained artifact.

matches.condition_checks: S1 met; S2 partial; S3 met; S4 unmet; S5 partial; H13-step3 met; H13-step4 partial (see expectations).

unassigned: Programming-abstraction contribution (signatures/modules) has no domain card; BootstrapFinetune is a weight branch outside harness scope (A3) and not credited.
revision_proposals: H13: note that demonstration-set bootstrapping by rejection sampling (no LLM mutation) is an in-scope variant (son55 proposal; stage end, not applied).

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Manufactured demonstrations form the genome; random search over demonstration sets against an executable end-to-end metric is the population search.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: No LLM mutation; selection on a dev set that is also reported for GSM8K.

claims.text: Compiled DSPy programs outperform standard few-shot prompting generally by over 25% (GPT-3.5) and 65% (llama2-13b-chat) within minutes.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: On GSM8K and HotPotQA with GPT-3.5 and Llama2-13b-chat, metric-filtered bootstrapped demonstrations retained in compiled programs raise official-test accuracy over zero-shot and random few-shot baselines and reach parity with expert demonstrations in some cells (author-reported, single compiles); the 49–88% headline range is dev/selection-set magnitude.

G.reason: Both seats 3; verified. Concrete bottleneck (hand-written prompt templates inside multi-stage LM pipelines) with lineage to DSP and prompt-optimisation work; nearest optimiser neighbours and STaR-style bootstrapping are only named, developer-burden claims are not measured, so not 4.

M.reason: Both seats 3; verified. Metric-filtered bootstrapping turns final-output labels into per-module demonstrations and discrete search selects among them; assumptions (decomposable program, end-to-end metric) are stated and predictions differ from random few-shot. Local credit is not certified and novelty over rationale bootstrapping is thin, so not 4.

X.reason: Both seats 3; verified. Compiler stages, pseudocode, k=8 / 16 trials / top-7 ensembles and data splits allow reconstruction; compiled demonstrations are written into predictors and reused at test. E.measurement.reason: Both seats 3; verified. Final numeric accuracy and answer EM / passage accuracy directly measure the tasks with none and random few-shot baselines; the vanilla program reasoning inside the answer field is permitted by the metric. No wider verifier audit.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; verified. Same-program none/fewshot/bootstrap contrasts attribute part of the gain to compilation, but the metric filter is never ablated, the strongest rows add up to 16 trials of dev search and 7-way voting that baselines do not get, and program-structure effects (CoT/reflection/multihop) are mixed into the headline.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 3; kept after a shared-error correction. Official GSM8K test (1.3k) and the held-out HotPotQA official validation sample are untouched by compilation and support the retained-demonstration claim for the reported rows. However the GSM8K dev column is the random-search selection set (opus:O02) and the abstract/Table-1 headline range 49–88% is taken from it (opus:O03); test counterparts are lower (81.6 / 46.9). Two benchmarks, pretraining contamination for GPT-3.5/Llama2 unaddressed. The clean test rows keep this at 3; the headline is narrowed in claims rather than re-scored.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1; verified against A2 ladder: split sizes and negative cells (Llama ensemble regression) are reported, only the random few-shot baseline is averaged over 3–5 runs, compiled programs are single compiles with no intervals or tests while 0.5 pp parity is interpreted.

E.cost.reason: Both seats 1; verified. Compile cost is given only qualitatively (minutes, a few thousand program runs); no token/dollar totals, ensemble inference multiplies cost and baselines are not charged for search or voting.
